description: This file defines API endpoints for managing and retrieving sports matches and events, utilizing FastAPI framework. It includes routes for getting lists of matches, live matches, match details, highlights, upcoming matches, as well as events and related matches. The code handles request parameters, applies filtering, pagination, and interacts with a database connection. It also organizes endpoints into two routers, one for main matches and one for events.

methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch a list of matches with optional filtering by status and sport, with pagination.

methods.description: Retrieves highlights for a specific match with pagination.
